name: BGA Interposer Wizard
description: Generate BGA interposer footprints with configurable depopulation and guide features
description_full: A KiCad 9 and 10 footprint wizard for BGA-style interposers, based on KiCad's bundled BGA wizard. Overall rows and columns and center-opening rows and columns are independently configurable, with optional symmetric corner depopulation. Pad size is entered in mils while the interposer geometry remains metric. Optional NPTH guide features include one round guide pin hole and independently selectable and rotatable oblong guide pin slots. The footprint origin can be the package center or guide pin hole center. Pad designators retain their full-grid locations across omitted positions.
